hypothesis: For this incremental current-position update, direct revision plus the existing final dependency check preserves required information as well as adding eight lens passes, at lower measured cost.
why_this_case: Real substantive baseline inspection replaces prior uncertainty; tests incorporation, historical preservation and no false product completion.
control: shared direct update + eight production lenses + production final dependency check
candidate: same direct update + production final dependency check
criteria: Updates the baseline from uninspected to source-inspected at the recorded commit; does not imply the working checkout changed.
Carries the missing prerequisite relationship and qualification/code-discovery connections, and the existing recognition and supplied-code handling.
Preserves historical product proofs as historical and bounded; does not infer they are installed on the selected baseline.
Distinguishes completed research from implementation; no automatic discount or overall delivery claim.
Preserves consequential unknowns: fresh tests and executable compatibility, runtime/database/recognition behavior, and alternate-path scope.
Preserves fixed goal and owner decisions; does not introduce new scope or authorization.
Material claims are supported by the supplied evidence, with usable source references and no misleading quotations.
Answer is usable for deciding remaining work; its readiness is consistent with the disclosed evidence boundary.
decision_rule: Compare both answers against every criterion using the frozen context, without treating the control or model self-approval as ground truth. Any material short-path regression rejects replacement. Equal quality favors lower measured calls/tokens/time for this case only. A needed revision means that bounded path did not finish; do not silently add calls.
assessment: Calling assistant reviews both raw answers and check verdicts; no extra judge call and no claim of independent blind review.
limits: One paired case, not general reliability; shared initial avoids initial-generation variance; live loop remains untouched.
